name: TESSERA Genomics Client Relations Blazer
description:
TESSERA's client-facing staff wear this blazer when meeting with prospective geneware clients, insurance liaisons, and regulatory consultants. It is constructed from a proprietary fabric called HELIXWEAVE — a blend of silk-comparable synthfiber and bioluminescent thread that produces a faint, shifting iridescence under standard office lighting. The effect is subtle: not flashy, but unmistakably alive-looking, which is precisely the point. The cut is structured and gender-neutral, available in three colorways — Void Teal, Pale Marrow, and Phenotype Gray — each corresponding loosely to the division the wearer represents (research, sales, and regulatory affairs respectively).

The blazer is tailored with a high back vent to allow for cosmetic geneware accommodations including small wing buds, decorative dorsal ridges, and TESSERA-brand bioluminescent skin modifications that clients may be wearing as demonstration products. Lapels carry a microscopic TESSERA helix embossed in the weave, invisible to the naked eye but detectable by near-field scanners — a subtle authentication mechanism that also functions as an employee tracking node. Junior staff receive this blazer on a loan basis; senior consultants are permitted to keep theirs upon departure, a perk that carries more symbolic weight than practical value.
cultural_context: The TESSERA blazer is instantly recognizable in GLMZ's biotech corridors and clinic waiting rooms. It signals access — the person wearing it can get you into TESSERA's service pipeline faster than a standard appointment queue. Former TESSERA client relations staff sometimes keep their blazers and wear them to freelance consulting gigs, trading on the brand recognition. Counterfeits exist but the embedded scanner-readable helix is difficult to replicate cheaply.
story_hooks: A player needs to get inside a TESSERA facility and a legitimate blazer is the lowest-risk entry vector.
A former TESSERA employee is still wearing their blazer six months after a controversial termination — and people keep treating them as if they still work there.
The tracking node embedded in a recovered blazer has been pinging a location in the Gray Zone for three weeks.
related_entities: Tessera Corponation ChronoMark VR-3 Passive Isotopic Citizen Tagging System

physical_description.visual_profile: A structured, high-shouldered blazer with an almost liquid quality to its surface. The fabric seems to shift between deep teal and gray depending on light angle, creating an unsettling sense of motion across the wearer's torso. Gender-neutral tailoring emphasizes clean lines and architectural precision. The silhouette is commanding without being aggressive — designed to convey trustworthiness and technical competence in equal measure.
physical_description.fit: Tailored but not slim; allows comfortable movement through the shoulders and torso. High back vent extends nearly to waist, creating dramatic negative space when the wearer moves. Slightly longer than standard blazers to accommodate bioluminescent skin modifications that may extend below the collarbone.
physical_description.primary_material: HELIXWEAVE — proprietary synthetic blend mimicking silk hand-feel with embedded bioluminescent thread at approximately 2% fiber density. The threads are dormant under standard lighting but activate under UV or near-field scanner stimulation.
physical_description.texture: Smooth and cool to touch, almost liquid-like. Surface has micro-quilted structure barely visible to the eye, providing subtle dimensionality. Lapels carry an imperceptible embossed helix pattern.
physical_description.color_scheme: Three colorways: Void Teal (primary — deep cyan with shadow-gray undertones), Pale Marrow (cream-white with faint phosphorescence), Phenotype Gray (cool neutral with metallic silver traces). All three carry subtle iridescent shift.
physical_description.closures: Single-button magnetic snap at chest, positioned slightly higher than traditional blazer closure. Additional friction-fit magnetic anchor points along interior for securing embedded tech or preventing gape.
distinctive_features: High back vent extending to waist — accommodates cosmetic geneware and dorsal modifications
Microscopic helix embossed in lapel weave, readable only by near-field scanners
Bioluminescent thread integration that becomes visible under UV or scanner activation
Interior tracking node embedded in shoulder seam — invisible but detectable
Reinforced neckline to support bioluminescent skin modification collar points
Subtle TESSERA house marking in thread pattern only visible under magnification
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3-4 corporate uniform — signals institutional access and biotech sector authority without flaunting wealth
physical_description.cultural_context: TESSERA client relations staff, biotech consultants, genetic modification industry insiders. Wearing this blazer grants psychological authority in medical and regulatory settings. Counterfeits are rare but exist among sub-grade identity entrepreneurs. Former employees keeping theirs signal 'I used to have access to TESSERA's pipeline' — still valuable in freelance consulting circles.
physical_description.condition_typical: Pristine when issued; worn examples show subtle creasing at elbows and back vent. High-use copies may show fading of bioluminescent thread or micro-cracking in the magnetic snap housing. Collector's condition blazers (senior staff departures) are often preserved immaculately.
